reference_scope: Visible face and hair appearance guidance for the fictional keeper only. The image does not establish actual identity, age, biography or role.

testcase_review.still_image_limit: C-R5 can support reader hand/book placement at a shade boundary and the neighbor eye-shielding; it cannot prove temporal book movement from a single still. C-R6 is appearance comparison, never actual-identity proof.
testcase_review.judgment_boundary: Metadata and prompt audits establish binding only. Actual pixel observations and requester preference remain separate.
